boundaries: Line 10863 (C19ah's own trailing comment) is outside coverage; line 10864 (this scope's own `BLEND_MODE_LABELS` declaration) begins this scope. Line 11146 (`#btn-bake-cache`'s click listener) is the last line of this scope; line 11147 opens the next leaf's (C19aj) `initToolbarCustomization` lead-in comment, confirmed disjoint by direct read (neither `#tl-toolbar` nor 'overflow button' appears anywhere in 10864-11146).
No lines inside 10864-11146 are excluded for another owner: every line belongs to exactly one of the five packets below, confirmed by the validator's packet-partition-equals-assigned-union check.

(a) Both dropdowns' full lifecycle as a state table. BLEND: open (`open(anchorEl)`, 10893-10951) sets `origMode` from `SMMotion.layerBlendModeAt` at the playhead if `ld.blendKeys` exists (10898, keyed-at-open), else the static `ld.blendMode||'normal'`; builds the option list from `BLEND_MODE_LABELS` marking the current value `.sel`. Hover-preview (`applyPreview(v)`, 10870-10881, wired to each option's `mouseenter` at 10904 and to the whole popup's `mouseleave` at 10954 with `v=origMode`) is a NO-OP whenever `ld.blendKeys&&ld.blendKeys.length` (10877, since `layerBlendModeAt` ignores the static field once keyed — writing it would have zero visible effect), otherwise writes `ld.blendMode=v==='normal'?undefined:v` (10878) and bumps `_sceneVersion`+`renderNow`. Commit (click, 10905-10942): keyed layers `pushUndo()` (10912) then `SMMotion.upsertBlendKeyAt(ld2,state.currentFrame,v)` (10913, snaps a hold-key at the CURRENT frame rather than overwriting the static field); non-keyed layers first restore `ld2.blendMode=origMode` (10919, so `pushUndo` snapshots the true pre-preview state) then `pushUndo()` (10920) then `applyPreview(v)` (10921, the real static write). Either path then `setLabel(v)`, nulls `origMode`, `close(false)`, and refreshes THREE surfaces (10939-10941: `SMMotion.renderMotionPropsPanel`, `renderLayerList`, `renderTimeline` — the 10926-10938 comment attributes the third refresh to feedback #213, a prior fix for the layer-list's own Blend pill going stale). Escape/outside-close (`close(revert)`, 10883-10887, wired to `document`'s `pointerdown` at 10956 and `window`'s `keydown` Escape at 10957): hides the popup and, if `revert&&origMode!==null`, calls `applyPreview(origMode)` to restore the pre-hover value. MATTE: identical shape (`open`/`applyPreview`/`setLabel`/`close`, 10982-11064) with two differences — `origMode=ld.matteMode||'none'` (11019, no keyed branch, no `SMMotion` reference anywhere in this IIFE) and a single-layer-document guard (`state.layers.length<2`, 11015-11018, shows a toast and returns before opening at all, since a matte source requires at least one other layer). Commit (11026-11046): restore-then-`pushUndo()`-then-`applyPreview(v)` (11028-11030, same shape as blend's non-keyed path — matte has no keyed path at all), then freezes `matteSourceLayerUid` at commit time (11031-11041: if `v!=='none'` and no source is set yet and there IS a layer above, stamps that layer's `layerUid` — generating one via `'ly_'+Date.now().toString(36)+'_'+Math.floor(Math.random()*1e6)` if it lacks one — into `ld3.matteSourceLayerUid`; if `v==='none'`, deletes `matteSourceLayerUid` outright), then `setLabel(v)`, nulls `origMode`, `close(false)`, and refreshes only `renderLayerList()` (11045, for the matte badge) — no `renderMotionPropsPanel`/`renderTimeline` refresh, since matte has no Motion-panel pill and no per-frame animated representation to redraw.

(b) The deliberate non-factoring rationale (10960-10968, the lead-in comment immediately after the blend IIFE's closing `})();`): the two dropdowns are 'independent small pieces of UI logic that happen to look alike today but read/write different layer fields and have already diverged once' — matte has no 'which other layer' concept, blend does not. Concrete divergences, diffed line-by-line: (1) matte's `open()` takes an `anchor` default of `dd` itself computed as a local var (11006) vs. blend's `open()` computing the anchor rect inline at use-time (10945) with no named local; (2) matte's `open()` has the single-layer-document early-return guard (11015-11018) with no blend equivalent; (3) blend's `applyPreview` has the keyed-layer no-op guard (10877) with no matte equivalent (matte's `applyPreview`, 10987-10992, is three lines, unconditional); (4) blend's commit branches on `ld2.blendKeys` to choose `upsertBlendKeyAt` vs. a plain restore-then-pushUndo-then-apply (10908-10922) — matte's commit (11026-11040) has only the one restore-then-pushUndo-then-apply shape, PLUS the source-freeze block blend has no equivalent of; (5) blend's post-commit refresh touches three surfaces (10939-10941), matte's touches one (11045); (6) blend's `setLabel` reads a static table (10882: `BLEND_MODE_LABELS[v]`), matte's reads a live-translated function (10993: `matteModeLabel(v)`, see (c)).
